description: DirMO-24 feat30 (team recipe, mean of seeds 42/1/2, 4x loss weight on observed speed >= 550 km/s) on the team raw-only df, leads 1-12 from a delta-target block-0 model, leads 25-72 moved by 0.25 x a level-free LightGBM residual model fit on out-of-fold forecasts of the training rows (as dirmo_24_feat30_pw4_d12_stack25_rawdf), except that the main model's blocks for leads 25-48 and 49-72 use 300 boosting rounds instead of 900, in the main fit and in the stack's cross-fit alike. Inputs filled causally; targets never filled (masked loss). Lab check (jsy301 round TC2, pre-registered, 5 windows 2023-07..2025-12 on the same df, raw truth; lab seeds 7/8/9 for the 300-round blocks): all leads -1.05 % vs the 900-round version [CI -2.12, -0.36], high-speed windows -1.27 %, quiet windows -0.77 %, -0.83 % vs the 900-round version shifted up by the same mean amount; without the stack refit the 300-round blocks were +0.31 % (worse). The main gate check passed thinly (-1.05 % vs a -1.0 % limit). This entry uses seeds 42/1/2 on all blocks. The 300 count follows the team top model's recipe and was first screened on the same windows (round TC lane 3). Not chosen by any board number.

data.gap_fill: inputs causal last value (observations unlimited, images <= 24 h, ENLIL none); y never filled
data.time_convention: newest input of origin O is the hour labelled O-1h; lead h target is hour O+h
data.training_rows: df fit_F1/fit_F2/fit_F3 (origin + 144 h <= cutoff), hourly origins

hyperparameters.base_score: block mean of the observed training targets (scalar)

loss_weight.rule: 4 if observed y >= 550 km/s else 1; 0 on missing y; mean 1 per lead over observed rows

short_leads.note: block-0 model on y - v_lag0 (same inputs, 4x@550 on the speed); its leads 1-12 replace the main
